'''Saki Fujita''' (Japanese: '''藤田咲''' ''Fujita Saki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Fujita was born on October 19, 1984, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. Fujita provided her voice for [[Anthea and Concordia|Anthea]], one of {{an|N}}'s foster sisters, in {{aniseries|BW}}. She then provided her voice for [[Lyn]], a [[character of the day]] who appeared in {{aniseries|XY}}. Later in {{aniseries|SM}}, her role was [[Pikala]]. Fujita was affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Arts Vision}}.
